about: Single source of every character, place and number plate. Session text, checks and the case DB use {{key}} / {{key.first}} placeholders (people) and {{key}} (places, plates). Rename here, rebuild, done. All names are fictional; surnames are deliberately from across India; places are names found in most Indian cities; plates use the national BH series.
premise: Tonight at midnight, reel star {{star}} from {{hometown}} is meant to sing her first stadium concert, in front of 40,000 fans. At 6 PM she is gone. She is not in her hotel room and her phone is switched off. You're the new intern at the City Police Data Cell. You have six hours, and your only witness is the data.

star.name: Tara Sen
star.bio: A young singer from {{hometown}} who became famous through her reels as @TARA. Tonight is her first stadium concert in the city, with 40,000 fans coming. At 6 PM she vanished from her hotel room, and her phone has been off ever since.

mentor.name: Ira Menon
mentor.bio: Sub-Inspector at the City Police Data Cell and your mentor tonight. She leads the search for {{star.first}}, hands you each new set of records, and has one rule: evidence, not rumours.

analyst.name: Kabir Shaikh
analyst.bio: The Data Cell's analyst. All night he collects records from the hotel, the cab company, the bank, the phone network and more, and loads them as tables for you to query.

sister.name: Mahi Sen
sister.bio: {{star.first}}'s younger sister and the person she trusts most. She is frightened for {{star.first}} and stays in touch with the police all night. Anything strange she hears, she passes on.

manager.name: Dev Arora
manager.bio: {{star.first}}'s manager. His company handles her bookings, contracts, travel and money, so he knows her plans better than anyone. He says he stayed at the hotel all evening.

rival.name: Nysa Kapoor
rival.bio: Another popular singer. Fans online love to compare her with {{star.first}}, so tonight some of them are pointing fingers at her.

fan.name: Ishita Das
fan.bio: Runs @tara_squad, {{star.first}}'s biggest fan club, from {{hometown}}. She posts about {{star.first}} all day and knows every detail of her life, which makes people online ask what else she knows.

driver.name: Sunny Gill
driver.bio: The cab driver {{star.first}} booked to take her from the hotel to the stadium, just before she disappeared. Online, people are already blaming him.

organiser.name: Kunal Bajaj
organiser.bio: The organiser of tonight's concert. Every ticket is sold, and if {{star.first}} does not walk on stage at midnight, he has the most to lose.
